name: Stenia
summary: The women's night before the Thesmophoria — aite and aischrologia for Demeter and Kore, when the jests that once made the mourning goddess smile are traded among the celebrants.
testimonia: Hesychius s.v. Στήνια (the women's festival and the abuse)
Apollodorus, Bibliotheca 1.5.1 (Iambe's jests as the charter for women's jokes at Demeter's rites)
